findings.note: NHL.com's projected lineup for Nov. 3 at Washington had Seguin on the third line with David Perron and Justin Hryckowian, behind the Johnston-Rantanen and Hintz-Robertson lines, so his even-strength assist chances look limited.

ESPN shows Seguin with 3 goals and 3 assists in 15 games in 2026-27, playing about 15:14 a night with no power-play assists. He had no points in 15:50 against Columbus earlier this season and none in 13:21 in his only November game.

CBS/RotoWire say Seguin had a strong game in which he scored and set up a Roope Hintz goal, and that he's trending upward after his ACL recovery. They also describe his role as middle-six and say he may still be rusty.
